_doc: Shared weapon afterimages, hit sparks and Weapon.img sounds. Bowman bows/crossbows and arrows belong to bowman.json (#199); Thief claws/daggers and throwing stars belong to thief.json (#207); Pirate knuckles/guns and bullets belong to pirate.json (#186). Afterimages stay shared. Potion steps beyond the three card gates (#229, spec #225, potions.schedule): Unagi 2022003, Pure Water 2022000, Ice Cream Pop 2001001 and Red Bean Sundae 2001002, each with its Item.wz/Consume entry (icon, recovery spec) and Sound.wz/Item.img Use sound; their names are in String.wz/Consume.img, which asset_manifest.json imports whole. Orange, White and Mana Elixir and their sounds stay in asset_manifest.json. Common-passive icons (spec #282 #283; icon, iconMouseOver, iconDisabled only) come from books no Adventurer line fragment imports, each pixel-identical to the Adventurer skill that names the passive (tier A, compared on v83 data): GM 910.img Haste 9101001 (= 4101004), Holy Symbol 9101002 (= 2311003), Super Dragon Roar 9101006 (= Dragon Roar 1311006; the Area icon) and Hyper Body 9101008 (= 1301007); Noblesse Recovery 10001001 (= 0001001); Dawn Warrior Iron Body 11001001 (= 1001003); Blaze Wizard Spell Booster 12101004 (= 2111005); Aran Maple Warrior 21121000 (= 2121000 and every Adventurer Maple Warrior). Sharp Eyes (Crit) is the one icon that is not here: its art exists only in Bowmaster 312.img 3121002, so it comes with the whole book in bowmaster.json (spec #332 #333; a whole img in one file and its sub-paths in another conflict).
